title: Annual EPF Dividend
description: Annual dividend rates declared by the EPF for conventional and Shariah-compliant investments.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is a yearly series

fields.name: conventional
fields.title: Conventional Dividend Rate
fields.description: [Float] The annual dividend rate declared for the conventional EPF scheme, expressed as a percentage

fields.name: shariah
fields.title: Shariah Dividend Rate
fields.description: [Float] The annual dividend rate declared for the Shariah-compliant EPF scheme, expressed as a percentage

methodology: Under the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Act 1991, the EPF is required to declare a minimum dividend of 2.5% for conventional investments; there is no specified minimum for Shariah-compliant investments. This dataset tabulates the actual dividend rates [declared by the EPF](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/others/resource-centre/dividend) for both conventional and Shariah-compliant investments.
caveat: The EPF's Simpanan Shariah was [launched in January 2017](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/w/registration-for-simpanan-shariah-opens-today) in response to high demand from EPF members during the Members' Consultation exercise. Consequently, the series for Shariah-compliant investments begins in 2017.
